name: Shame Shack The Game
source:
It's summer vacation and the girls have been sent to camp by their long-suffering parents! Luna has been dreaming of this moment ever since she knew she was going - alone in a room with four other girls, and with no adult supervision!

Now Erin, Riley, Ivy, and Charlie are snoring away, just what can our favorite little pervert get away with? Will she wake anyone up? And what will be the dire consequences if her degeneracy is discovered?

Cum sneak around with Luna and indulge in your shame...

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/games/shame-shack-the-game]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
暑假来临，不胜其烦的家长们把女孩们统统送进了夏令营！自从得知自己要去夏令营的那一刻起，露娜就一直梦想着这一幕——与另外四个女孩独处一室，而且身边没有任何大人看管！

眼下艾琳、赖莉、艾薇与查莉正呼呼大睡，我们最爱的小色鬼究竟能趁机干出多少坏事而不被抓包？她会不小心吵醒谁吗？一旦她不堪入目的行径败露，又会招致怎样可怕的后果？

快跟着露娜偷偷摸摸行动起来，尽情沉溺于羞耻的快感之中吧……
